summary: Barry Lover shares podcasting tips focused on episode notes and social media optimization, emphasizing the importance of including searchable keywords in episode descriptions to improve discoverability through future podcast app search features. He recommends linking Android and iOS download options directly in social media profiles using link trees and advises users to Google their podcast while signed out to avoid algorithmic bias. Specific examples include the podcast 'Tea with Q and J' and mentions of apps like Google Podcasts, Pocket Cast, and CastBox.
